reviews.text: Friendly staff. We came here to train our Breton and the highly trained trainer. Our goal is to get him into rallying.

I regularly attend this dog training center to practice agility with my dog ​​under Simone's expert guidance. The technical director is Vittorio Papavero, a leading name in dog sports, both in Italy and abroad. The trainers are well-trained and friendly professionals. I highly recommend it for anyone who wants to practice a dog sport or train their furry friend.

I do agility at the Why Not Dog dog training center with Federica, who has been with us for years with professionalism and kindness. She's a true asset! The camp has plenty of space, where every dog ​​can find their space, their sport, and, most importantly, the right trainer. If you have puppies, Simone is definitely the right person for you. Highly recommended!
Very welcoming center where our dogs can enjoy outdoor activities! The trainers are very professional!
Excellent dog training center. My dog ​​Milo and I are learning while having fun and building a stronger bond. Simone, the trainer, is truly talented and highly trained.

I attended the dog training course at Wy Not Dog dog training center in 2024 and can confirm that it was a highly educational experience. The professionalism and preparation of the instructors were exceptional: each lesson was conducted with expertise, and each instructor was able to convey theoretical and practical knowledge in a clear and engaging manner.
The course organization was impeccable, with particular attention to detail and the support provided to the students. Although the course was challenging and complex, it offered comprehensive training, covering all the areas necessary to successfully perform as a trainer. A close-knit group of participants formed, which made the experience even more rewarding and enriching. I highly recommend this center to anyone looking for serious training in dog training.
Wonderful place, wonderful people to explore with your 4-legged friend

Today I competed in the agility competition at this center. The staff were friendly, but I'm disappointed they've adopted the philosophy of giving away pasta to the winners. I'm also celiac, so I can't stand it. A certificate filled out on the spot would be enough to have a souvenir of the day, or some dog biscuits, like they used to do.

Stunning facility 🙂 truly meticulously maintained.
Ample space and fields, both for running our four-legged friends and for training. …
